Pilot · Russia

Damir Yusupov

Ural Airlines Flight 1782019
Flight
Ural Airlines Flight 178
Date
15 August 2019
Aircraft
Airbus A321
Location
Near Zhukovsky, Moscow region
Survivors
233 of 233 aboard

After bird strikes damaged both engines just after takeoff near Moscow, he landed the Airbus A321 in a cornfield. All 233 people aboard survived.

Who helped

  • Georgy Murzin First officerFlew as co-pilot alongside the captain through the bird-strike emergency and the cornfield landing; he was injured and later named a Hero of Russia.Sources: 1 2 3Photo: Alexey Druzhinin / Russia's Presidential Press and Informati · CC BY 4.0
  • Dmitry Ivlitsky Senior flight attendantLed the cabin evacuation, told passengers to leave their bags, and used a loudspeaker to guide them away from the aircraft through the cornfield.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Nadezhda Vershinina Flight attendantWas one of the five flight attendants who evacuated all 226 passengers from the aircraft; she was awarded the Order of Courage.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Dmitry Goncharenko Flight attendantWas one of the five flight attendants who evacuated all 226 passengers from the aircraft; he was awarded the Order of Courage.Sources: 1 2 3
  • Aliya Slyakaeva Flight attendantWas one of the five flight attendants who evacuated all 226 passengers from the aircraft; she was awarded the Order of Courage.Sources: 1 2 3
  • Yana Yagodina Flight attendantWas one of the five flight attendants who evacuated all 226 passengers from the aircraft; she was awarded the Order of Courage.Sources: 1 2 3
